title: gloss/v2
description: The YAML front matter of nodes/<id>/gloss/<hash>.md or targets/<id>/gloss/<hash>.md (F20-R1; D-3 v3.30): prose saying what one Lean file says — a statement, witness or relation of a node of any status, or a definition module — naming the hash of the exact text described. The body is Markdown, contributor or model text, untrusted downstream. Content-hashed, attributed, unverified, versioned by supersedes, withdrawn by a withdrawal record. Exactly one of author and drafter is set. v2 adds drafted_with (F21-R6; D-3 v3.31, D-23): the model a contributor's agent drafted with. No new version may carry a drafter block (F21-R2). Versioned, never edited (D-34).

node.description: The node, for a statement, witness or relation; null for a definition module.

module.description: The definition module's path under targets/<id>/defs/, for a definition; null otherwise.

lean_hash.description: SHA-256 of the Lean file's bytes this gloss describes; must equal the file at merge (F20-R3).

supersedes.description: The hash of the version this one replaces — the head of its chain, never one already superseded or withdrawn (D-3 v3.30); null to start a chain.

author.description: The login or pseudonym that wrote this version; null for a draft (then drafter is set).

drafter.description: Set for a draft by the network's drafter (D-3 v3.30), with no human author: its name, the model and version that wrote the text, and the commit of the graph its input was read at.

drafted_with.description: The model and tooling that drafted this version, in the contributor's words (D-23, D-3 v3.31): null or absent for a person's own writing. Contributor text, untrusted downstream.
